title: vernonia arborescens
intro: Vernonia arborescens, commonly known as Ironweed, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Vernonia arborescens include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of fever and rheumatism. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
